data.name: Khatijah
data.gender_notes: Khatijah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khatijah is the name of the first wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is derived from the Arabic root 'k-h-t', which means 'to be pure, sincere, compact, or intimate'. Khatijah was a loving and supportive wife, and her story is an inspiration for women in Islam. The name Khatijah carries the meaning “Pure, Sincere, Compact, Intimate Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khatijah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, sincere, compact, intimate friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
